mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPI YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS decreases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY.
